# VyaparSethu — Protected Trade Infrastructure

## About
VyaparSethu (formerly Bell24h) is India's B2B Trade Network connecting verified buyers and suppliers across 450+ categories.
Mission: Wipe Out Bad Debt. Tagline: Commerce Connections Globally.
Built by Digitex Studio (VyaparSethu Technologies Private Limited — registration in progress).
Website: https://www.vyaparsethu.com | Legacy: https://www.bell24h.com (transitioning)

## Three Pillars
1. Verified Matching — no fake suppliers, no fake buyers. GST verification + manual review.
2. Protected Payment — Razorpay nodal escrow. Money held until both sides confirm delivery.
3. Faster Trade — Quotation in 24h, Order in 48h, Settlement in 7 days.

## Key Features
- Speak Requirement (Voice): Record procurement needs via microphone; Groq Whisper v3 transcribes and extracts category, budget, timeline in real time.
- Video Requirement: Submit video-based requirements with AI analysis.
- Text Requirement: Traditional text-based requirement posting.
- Verified Supplier Matching: AI-powered matching across 450+ categories.
- Protected Payment: Secure escrow via Razorpay. Buyer holds funds until delivery confirmed.
- Trade Account: In-app trade balance (RBI-compliant). Not a wallet — a Trade Account.
- Trade Confidence Score: Algorithmic 0–100 trust rating, computed daily at 2 AM IST.
- GST Auto-fill: Automatic GST number validation and business details fetch.
- Business Conversations: Structured messaging between buyers and verified suppliers.
- DPDP Compliance: India Data Protection Act 2023 — consent audit logs, right to erasure.

## Correct Terminology
- Say "Quotation" or "Requirement" — not "RFQ"
- Say "Speak Requirement" — not "Voice RFQ"
- Say "Video Requirement" — not "Video RFQ"
- Say "Protected Payment" — not "Escrow"
- Say "Verified Supplier" — not "Vendor"
- Say "Trade Account" — not "Wallet"
- Say "Business Operations" — not "Procurement"
- Say "Trade Network" — not "Marketplace"
- Say "Business Conversations" — not "Chat"

## How It Works
1. Buyer posts a Requirement (voice, video, or text) — free, 90 seconds.
2. VyaparSethu AI matches with Verified Suppliers in that category.
3. Suppliers submit Quotations within 24 hours.
4. Buyer compares, selects, pays via Protected Payment (escrow).
5. Supplier delivers. Both sides confirm. Payment releases. Settlement in 7 days.

## Trade Confidence Score Formula
30% Payment History + 20% On-time Delivery + 15% Response Speed
+ 15% Repeat Orders + 10% Dispute Rate + 10% Verification Strength = Score out of 100
Computed daily at 2 AM IST via Vercel Cron. Never real-time.

## Tech Stack
Next.js 14 App Router, Neon PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, Groq Whisper v3 (voice transcription),
Razorpay (payments + escrow), MSG91 (OTP), Polygon blockchain (optional escrow layer),
Cloudflare (DNS, proxy, WAF, email routing), Vercel (hosting).
